title: usage: a web search sent to Kimi Code's or WorkBuddy's search service, or to a search API, leaves no row in Usage › Requests
head: f6064d5d6b1785760972ca2f6fe7f63e7776d747
testCommands: GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.8 go build -tags nogui ./...

gofmt -l internal/gateway/search.go internal/gateway/search_api.go internal/gateway/search_kimi.go internal/gateway/search_workbuddy.go internal/gateway/search_usage_test.go internal/gateway/usage_cache_zero_split_test.go
testsAdded: internal/gateway/search_usage_test.go: TestSearchesWriteARequestRow — each of kimiSearch, wbSearch and askSearchAPI writes exactly one usage row, Kind web_search, under its provider (Tavily for the search API), status 200, with no tokens, and the ledger's token sums do not move
countingChoice: The row is logged and counted as a call, like a model search's row (its Kind is the same web_search and Usage's totals count every non-rejected record); its tokens, cache counts and cost are 0, so token and cost totals do not change. No counting code was changed; Calls goes up by one per search, as it already did for a search made by a searcher's model. usage_cache_zero_split_test.go's wantCacheLedger was narrowed to the turn's row, since a search made for a turn now writes its own row (as a model's search already did).
unverifiedBoundaries: The Recent-calls ring (s.record) is not written for these three paths: only the Usage › Requests ledger row is, since there is no agent protocol or model to name in a Call
A search that fails before its request goes out (a masking error, a WorkBuddy Sign failure) still writes a row with status 0 and the error, which is how a failed call reads; not exercised by a test
No live Kimi Code/WorkBuddy account or real search API key was used: the paths are exercised against the package's fake services
preExistingRed: internal/gateway TestClaudeClientCacheAbsentUnchanged fails at the clean base c0985122 as well (gateway-package.log, base-pre-existing-claude-cache.log); it is a Claude CLI argument assertion unrelated to this change
